candidate_state: planned from the verified release-preparation commit

internal_measurement.evaluator: material-only release validation; no new evaluator adopted
internal_measurement.results: Workspace release tests with all features, Clippy with warnings denied, rustfmt, rustdoc with warnings denied, the optional opening-book feature, release and trainer Python tests, documentation and public-surface checks, a native material-only USI smoke, the 90.08% engine/library line-coverage gate, WebAssembly package generation, and WebAssembly package metadata validation passed. This release hardens USI game boundaries, match and gate evidence preservation, option validation, and the 90% Rust coverage contract. No general playing-strength claim is made.

external_opponents.configuration: No external engine, evaluator, weights, labels, Suisho5-derived scores, or Suisho5-derived opening positions are used as release evidence for v0.3.68.

known_limitations: No new NNUE checkpoint is bundled or adopted, and this release makes no general playing-strength claim.
The robustness and coverage changes improve failure detection and evidence integrity but do not by themselves prove playing-strength improvement.
The optional v0.3.38 checkpoint and its material-baseline recommendation remain unchanged.
Parallel search can vary by scheduler; deterministic diagnostics require one thread and SpecTopN=0.
The WebAssembly package is distributed as a GitHub Release asset and is not published to the npm registry.
Hosted CI remains the required browser-level WebAssembly check; local release validation covered package generation and metadata.
External HalfKP inference remains optional and requires a separately obtained, license-compatible nn.bin file with its own provenance and operating scale.
